reference: Actual original frozen ggml_mul_mat with F16 left and F32 right, one CPU thread. Full strided source bytes and raw original outputs captured before Rust comparison.

hypothetical_f16_rhs.purpose: Explicit negative control; the native source keeps query/probability activations in F32 for F16 left tensors.

scope: KQ uses actual nonzero head-offset views, cache slot/head-axis permutation, larger physical row strides and GQA broadcasting.
PV uses transposed-cache orientation with physical KV columns contiguous and row/head capacity padding.
256/512/768 physical KV widths, widths and tails around 32/64/256/512, multi-token/multi-head/two-sequence batches, sparse masked probabilities and cancellation-sensitive queries.
MSVC __SSE2__ absent and GNU default SSE2 are distinct source profiles; GGML_SIMD is absent in both frozen builds, so F16 dot uses source F32 products/F64 scalar accumulation.
This is a tensor-kernel fixture; it does not by itself prove complete context/cache semantics.
